nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Warning
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking API/convention/file-structure changes from training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Local Mode (Docker/img2 ui)
nodes.rationale: When run locally via img2 ui/docker compose, per-IP rate limiting is disabled and output size caps are lifted since there's no shared public resource to protect.

nodes.label: Direct Browser-to-Server Upload
nodes.rationale: Browser calls the FastAPI server directly (lib/convert.ts) instead of proxying through Next.js API routes, avoiding Vercel Functions' 4.5MB request body limit that caused 413 errors on larger images when uploads were proxied through /api/analyze and /api/convert.

nodes.label: server/VERSION Semver Policy
nodes.rationale: Server deploys independently from frontend (Railway/Docker), so VERSION carries its own semver bumped per PR to signal behavior changes and confirm deploys shipped; docs/CI-only changes don't bump it, and the bump must land in the same commit as the code change to keep the two systems' versions traceable to actual behavior differences.
